periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The major axis of the eye patches is oriented obliquely, slanting downward and inward toward the midline of the face at approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated ovoid geometry, with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering effect, with the lower margin of the patch extending significantly further from the geometric center than the upper margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is substantial in height, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible lateral torso height at the shoulder transition.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ear regions are positioned laterally with a wide gap approximately equivalent to 2.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are characterized by a smooth, continuous semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible accumulation of light-colored wood shavings or substrate particles on the fur of the lower abdomen and the right forelimb.
